hook.en: At a big vegetable market every farmer sells the same tomatoes at the same price. Why can no farmer charge more? Welcome to perfect competition.
hook.kn: ದೊಡ್ಡ ತರಕಾರಿ ಮಾರುಕಟ್ಟೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಪ್ರತಿ ರೈತನೂ ಒಂದೇ ತರಹದ ಟೊಮೆಟೊವನ್ನು ಒಂದೇ ಬೆಲೆಗೆ ಮಾರುತ್ತಾನೆ. ಯಾರೂ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಬೆಲೆ ಏಕೆ ಕೇಳಲಾರರು? ಇದೇ ಪರಿಪೂರ್ಣ ಸ್ಪರ್ಧೆ.

objectives.en: List the defining features of perfect competition
Explain why a firm is a price taker
Describe the firm's horizontal demand curve

narration.en: At a big vegetable market every farmer sells the same tomatoes at the same price. Why can no farmer charge more? Welcome to perfect competition.
narration.kn: ದೊಡ್ಡ ತರಕಾರಿ ಮಾರುಕಟ್ಟೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಪ್ರತಿ ರೈತನೂ ಒಂದೇ ತರಹದ ಟೊಮೆಟೊವನ್ನು ಒಂದೇ ಬೆಲೆಗೆ ಮಾರುತ್ತಾನೆ. ಯಾರೂ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಬೆಲೆ ಏಕೆ ಕೇಳಲಾರರು? ಇದೇ ಪರಿಪೂರ್ಣ ಸ್ಪರ್ಧೆ.

body.en: A perfectly competitive market has: (1) a very large number of buyers and sellers, each too small to affect price; (2) a homogeneous (identical) product; (3) free entry and exit of firms; (4) perfect information about prices and products. Because of these, each firm is a price taker: price is set by market demand and supply, and the firm can sell as much as it wants at that price.

points.en: Very large number of buyers and sellers
Result: firm is a price taker

narration.en: Perfect competition has many buyers and sellers, an identical product, free entry and exit, and perfect information. So every firm is a price taker.
narration.kn: ಪರಿಪೂರ್ಣ ಸ್ಪರ್ಧೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಅನೇಕ ಖರೀದಿದಾರರು ಮತ್ತು ಮಾರಾಟಗಾರರು, ಏಕರೂಪದ ಸರಕು, ಮುಕ್ತ ಪ್ರವೇಶ ಮತ್ತು ನಿರ್ಗಮನ, ಪರಿಪೂರ್ಣ ಮಾಹಿತಿ ಇರುತ್ತವೆ. ಆದ್ದರಿಂದ ಪ್ರತಿ ಸಂಸ್ಥೆಯೂ ಬೆಲೆ ಸ್ವೀಕಾರಕ.

title.en: Industry sets the price, the firm takes it

say.en: On the left is the whole industry. Market demand and market supply cross at a price of 20 rupees.
On the right is one small firm. It takes the price of 20 as given: its demand curve is a horizontal line.
If the firm asks more than 20, buyers go elsewhere. It has no reason to ask less, because it can sell all it wants at 20.

narration.en: On the left is the whole industry. Market demand and market supply cross at a price of 20 rupees.

title.en: Why the firm is a price taker

body.en: Since the product is identical and buyers know all prices, a firm that charges even slightly more than the market price loses all its customers. Since each firm is tiny relative to the market, it can sell any quantity at the market price, so it has no reason to charge less. Hence the demand curve facing the firm is perfectly elastic (horizontal) at the market price. Free entry and exit mean that, in the long run, firms earn only normal profit.

points.en: Firm's demand curve: horizontal at market price

narration.en: A firm charging more loses all buyers, and it can sell everything at the market price, so its demand curve is horizontal.
narration.kn: ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಬೆಲೆ ಕೇಳಿದ ಸಂಸ್ಥೆ ಎಲ್ಲ ಖರೀದಿದಾರರನ್ನು ಕಳೆದುಕೊಳ್ಳುತ್ತದೆ; ಮಾರುಕಟ್ಟೆ ಬೆಲೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಎಲ್ಲವನ್ನೂ ಮಾರಬಹುದು. ಆದ್ದರಿಂದ ಸಂಸ್ಥೆಯ ಬೇಡಿಕೆ ರೇಖೆ ಅಡ್ಡ ರೇಖೆ.

problem.en: There are 500 tomato farmers at a market and the price is ₹20 per kg. Farmer Ramu brings 100 kg. What happens if he asks ₹22? Should he ask ₹18?

steps.en: At ₹22: buyers can get identical tomatoes from 499 other farmers at ₹20, so Ramu sells nothing.
At ₹20: he can sell all 100 kg, earning 20 × 100 = ₹2,000; his 100 kg are too small to change the market price.
At ₹18: he would still sell 100 kg but earn only ₹1,800. He has no reason to cut the price.

answer.en: Ramu is a price taker: he sells all 100 kg at ₹20 (₹2,000); at ₹22 he sells nothing, at ₹18 he loses ₹200.

narration.en: Let us work this out together. There are 500 tomato farmers at a market and the price is ₹20 per kg. Farmer Ramu brings 100 kg. What happens if he asks ₹22? Should he ask ₹18?

body.en: Many sellers, Identical goods, Free entry, Full information.

narration.en: Four features. Many sellers, Identical goods, Free entry, Full information.

points.en: Perfect competition: many sellers, identical goods, free entry and exit, perfect information.
points.kn: ಪರಿಪೂರ್ಣ ಸ್ಪರ್ಧೆ: ಅನೇಕ ಮಾರಾಟಗಾರರು, ಏಕರೂಪದ ಸರಕು, ಮುಕ್ತ ಪ್ರವೇಶ-ನಿರ್ಗಮನ, ಪರಿಪೂರ್ಣ ಮಾಹಿತಿ.

points.en: Each firm is a price taker.
The firm's demand curve is horizontal at the market price.
points.kn: ಸಂಸ್ಥೆಯ ಬೇಡಿಕೆ ರೇಖೆ ಮಾರುಕಟ್ಟೆ ಬೆಲೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಅಡ್ಡ ರೇಖೆ.

homework.en: Explain any three features of perfect competition with an example from an Indian market.

narration.en: Recap. Perfect competition: many sellers, identical goods, free entry and exit, perfect information. Each firm is a price taker. The firm's demand curve is horizontal at the market price.
narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ. ಪರಿಪೂರ್ಣ ಸ್ಪರ್ಧೆ: ಅನೇಕ ಮಾರಾಟಗಾರರು, ಏಕರೂಪದ ಸರಕು, ಮುಕ್ತ ಪ್ರವೇಶ-ನಿರ್ಗಮನ, ಪರಿಪೂರ್ಣ ಮಾಹಿತಿ. ಪ್ರತಿ ಸಂಸ್ಥೆಯೂ ಬೆಲೆ ಸ್ವೀಕಾರಕ. ಸಂಸ್ಥೆಯ ಬೇಡಿಕೆ ರೇಖೆ ಮಾರುಕಟ್ಟೆ ಬೆಲೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಅಡ್ಡ ರೇಖೆ.
